title: OpenAI and Foxconn collaborate to strengthen U.S. manufacturing across the AI supply chain
summary_lines: OpenAI and Foxconn are collaborating to design and manufacture next-generation AI infrastructure hardware in the U.S. The partnership will develop multiple generations of data-center systems, strengthen U.S. supply chains, and build key components domestically to accelerate advanced AI infrastructure.
